description:
An experienced martial fighter; the listed level and source equipment guide the combat silhouette. Source inventory: Javelin +1, Two-handed sword +2, Chain armor +1. Readied: Two-handed sword +2, Chain armor +1. Source wealth: 15 cp.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT READY
EDIT ONLY THE WEAPON ARM of the attached finished javelin ACTION fighter into a READY frame for MON5CHA.DAX:84/item_000__ranged. Reference image 1 is the UNMARKED action sprite and is the authoritative fighter identity, body, armor, red waist cloth, pose, canvas, and foot anchor. Reference image 2 is a PLANNING ANNOTATION of that same action: RED circles and lines trace the arm that extends toward screen right, from its shoulder around x71,y42 through elbow x86,y41 to empty hand x105,y38. BLUE circles the OTHER hand near x56,y53. RED also indicates where the weapon-bearing hand should return near x81,y26. The red and blue marks are annotations only; do not show them in final art. Reference image 3 is the same fighter's approved two-handed-sword ready art for identity and human height. Reference image 4 is the approved bipedal pose guide for camera and attack timing, not identity. All are independently created replacement art.

THIS IS THE KEY OPERATION: Bend the RED-MARKED, viewer-RIGHT arm BACK and UP around ITS OWN shoulder x71,y42, making its same hand grip a long recognizable JAVELIN +1 near x81,y26 in a poised throwing position. The shaft angles upward, stays inside the PNG and does not cross the one-square footprint side boundaries. Its sharp metal tip is clearly visible. Keep the BLUE-MARKED other arm bent near the chest, empty and unchanged. Do NOT move the weapon to the viewer-left arm. Do NOT turn the offhand into the throwing arm. The final ready image must make it possible to extend this exact javelin-bearing arm to the right to recreate reference image 1's after-throw pose.

Keep the ENTIRE head, chain armor +1, red waist cloth, belt, torso, hips, legs, feet, stance width, facing, body height and canvas origin of reference image 1. Do not redraw or translate the full figure; this is a local arm-and-weapon edit only. The body is a normal five-foot human in one combat square, approximately 88 source pixels head to soles, head around y22, soles around y111 in a 128x128 canvas. Face screen right in front three-quarter view, chest partly visible. Genuine transparent crisp pixel art; no sword, shield, bow, projectile, magic, ground, background, grid, text, colored markers, checkerboard, black box, seam, or motion blur. One READY figure only.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT ACTION
EDIT the attached NEW javelin READY sprite into ONE ACTION frame for MON5CHA.DAX:84/item_000__ranged. Reference image 1 is the UNMARKED full-resolution new ready image and controls all actual art. Reference image 2 is an ANNOTATED PLANNING COPY: RED dots trace the javelin-bearing arm from the VIEWER-LEFT shoulder near x42,y43 through elbow near x33,y40 to hand near x31,y28, and the RED line indicates its required forward path to about x108,y43. BLUE marks the OTHER hand near x64,y55; that hand must remain bent near the chest. Do not render any red or blue planning marks. Reference image 3 is the unmarked 128x128 ready export showing exact body and foot registration. Reference image 4 is the approved bipedal pose guide for front three-quarter view and action timing, not identity. All are independent replacement art, not original game art.

The javelin has just been THROWN to screen right. The SAME VIEWER-LEFT ARM that gripped it in ready must visibly follow through: start from the viewer-left shoulder at x42,y43, extend the upper arm across the FRONT of the chest to a clearly connected elbow and wrist, and finish with an EMPTY open hand to screen right around x105-112,y38-46. This is the arm that was raised behind the head in ready. The OTHER, viewer-right arm and its hand stay flexed near x64,y55 and do not become the thrower. No javelin remains in either hand or in the image. An action that extends the viewer-right arm while the original throwing arm stays bent is WRONG. Show the instant after release, not a windup, dropped hand, pointing gesture, or sword swing.

Keep the SAME dark-haired sixth-level human fighter in chain armor +1 and red waist cloth. The head, connected torso, waist, hips, legs, boots and both planted soles must stay at the SAME canvas coordinates and pixel scale as the ready export. The head-to-feet body height stays about 88 source pixels, with head around y24 and soles around y111 on a 128x128 canvas. Do not shrink or enlarge the body, translate it, change stance width, slide the feet or shear torso from hips. Modest shoulder rotation is allowed solely for the rightward throw. Face screen right, front three-quarter, chest partly visible. Genuine transparent crisp pixel-art cutout with border margin; no other weapon, shield, bow, trail, magic, background, checkerboard, text, shadow, motion blur, marker, or opaque box. Output ACTION ONLY.

FINAL ART ASSEMBLY: Rejected full ready/action drafts that put the javelin in a different arm from the extended empty action arm or changed body scale. The accepted action uses the newly generated forward-follow-through figure as the fixed full-body base. The accepted ready reuses that identical head, torso, legs and planted feet, with a newly generated raised javelin arm mirrored and attached to the SAME viewer-right shoulder that extends in action. Transparent feathered masking removes the old outstretched ready arm and blends the raised arm into the shoulder. The ready javelin points back/up-left; in action that exact arm extends toward screen right after release with an empty hand. Both frames share one normal-human body scale and exact foot contacts.
